
Parameters
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Fixed parameters

```{r}
plot_par(subset(fixed_par, par != "n0"), color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols)
```

`r if (any(fixed_par$par == "n0")) "### Fixed initial abundance"`

```{r, eval = any(fixed_par$par == "n0")}
plot_trend(subset(fixed_par, par == "n0"), x = ~age, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Initial abundance")
```


Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Random parameters (r)

Recruitment states below begin in year 2. The fixed first-year anchor is
reported as `r0`; the population recruitment panel includes every year.

```{r}
plot_trend(random_par$log_r, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "r")
```

`r if ("log_n" %in% names(random_par)) "### (n)"`

```{r, eval = "log_n" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_n, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "n")
```

`r if ("log_n0" %in% names(random_par)) "### Initial abundance"`

```{r, eval = "log_n0" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_n0, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Initial abundance")
```

### (f)

```{r}
plot_trend(random_par$log_f, x = ~year, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "f")
```

`r if ("log_m" %in% names(random_par)) "### (m)"`

```{r, eval = "log_m" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_m, x = ~year, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age_block, ylab = "m")
```
